chooseGroupTypeQuestion: What kind of group do you want to create?
publicGroupDescription: Anyone can find, join, and view group content. Suitable for connecting with a large learning community.
privateGroupDescription: Only invited members can join and view content. Suitable for groups of friends or classes.

step1.title: Basic Information
step1.groupNameHelper: A clear name helps others easily find the group
step1.groupDescriptionPlaceholder: What is this group about? What are the learning goals? Who should join?
step1.groupDescriptionHelper: A detailed description helps attract the right members

step2.title: Topics & Fields
step2.description: Help people find your group more easily
step2.topicsHelper: Choose 1-3 topics for people to easily find your group
step2.allLevelsDescription: Suitable for everyone, from beginners to experts
step2.beginnerDescription: For those who are just starting to learn
step2.intermediateDescription: Already have foundational knowledge and want to develop further
step2.advancedDescription: For experienced and highly specialized individuals
step2.activityFrequencyHelper: Helps members know the group's interaction level
step2.dailyDescription: Group active and interacts every day
step2.flexibleDescription: No fixed schedule, depends on members
step2.canChangeLater: You can change this again later in group settings

step3.title: Rules & Settings
step3.description: Set up a positive learning environment for your group
step3.rulesDescription: Set rules to help the group operate effectively and civilly
step3.rulesMaxInfo: Maximum 10 rules. The first rule cannot be deleted.
step3.approvalDescription: Admin approves before new members join the group
step3.approvalInfo: Public groups usually don't need approval to increase connectivity
step3.postingPermissionsQuestion: Who can create posts in the group?
step3.adminModeratorOnlyDescription: Strictly control content posted in the group
step3.groupLinkDescription: Create an easy-to-remember link to share the group
step3.groupLinkInfo: Only use lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens

step4.title: Preview & Create Group
step4.description: Review information and complete group creation
step4.previewDescription: This is how people will see the group in search
step4.inviteFriendsDescription: Send invitations to people you know who are interested (optional)
step4.publicGroupInfo: Public groups will appear in search and can be joined by anyone. You can change this setting later in group management.

validation.rulesMax: You can only add up to 10 rules

errors.slugExists: This link is already in use
